items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know anybody in New York except Cannonball and Sandra, and Nat, of course.

ctx.x: No, John Levy set all that up. I did not. I didn’t know anybody in New York except Cannonball and Sandra, and Nat, of course.
So what was it like to walk into this demo session knowing that you were this far from getting the other half of what you wanted?
